banker.text: Coins are safest where pirates can't count them. Here.
Ah, the sweet silence of money doing nothing.
All of it? Was it something my strongbox said?
Three percent. The camel who carries the news must eat.
That much gold, from dates? Remarkable dates.

moneyLender.text: My favorite captain! Every captain is my favorite until the due date.
Fifteen percent a moon. A bargain, if you don't think about it.
On time? You've taken all the fun out of lending.
Late! My cousin has a fast ship and very few hobbies.
Not today? Debt is patient. Like me.

shipwright.text: Show me the damage. Don't tell me the story, the planks will.
Did you fight a pirate or a mountain?
Two weeks and she'll outrun her own shadow.
Sixty percent. Love fades, wood rots, prices fall.
Treat her better than the last one. I saw the last one.

bazaarMerchant.text: Dates! Salt! Copper! Pearls! Everything except a discount!
Buy more, my children need new children.
At that price I should be the captain and you the merchant!
You bought it all. Now what do I shout about?

farida.text: You walked in like a customs man. Walk out like a friend.
Gunpowder? I see only... very angry sand.
Papers for you. First run's on me. Second run, I own your soul. Joking. Mostly.
You got caught? With MY papers? Hold them right-side up next time.
Rich and alive. My two favorite things in a customer.
